Verified end-to-end in `/home/kara` against a realistic 10-package fixture whose per-package summaries sum to the problem's ground truth (48 files / 500 tests):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Aggregate main fixture | `Test Files 48, Tests 500, Packages 10` ✅ |
| README before | `163 tests across 16 files` (tagline, body, coverage line) |
| README after | `500 tests across 48 files` everywhere; stale-ref grep = **0**, new-ref grep = **3** ✅ |
| Idempotency | Re-run → "no change (already current)", exit 3 ✅ |
| Edge: failing package (`Test Files 1 failed \| 2 passed (3)`, `Tests 2 failed \| 10 passed (12)`) | Parenthesized totals used: **3 files / 12 tests** ✅ (naive "first number" parsing would have under-counted) |
| Edge: pnpm `packages/utils:` stream prefixes | Parsed correctly ✅ |
| Edge: log with no summaries | `exit 2` with clear message ✅ |
| Edge: missing arg | `exit 1` usage error ✅ |

Note: no actual repo exists in this environment, so the run script was exercised against a fixture replicating the reported suite shape; the same pipeline (tee → sum → update) is the drop-in fix for the real workspace.
